metadata.title: How Nvidia's latest deal continues to target all points of the AI trade

content.text:
Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to report on Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition of Hugging Face, the company's bet on open AI models, and now accounting for 8% of the S&P 500 market cap.
And Inez, this is not Nvidia's first big deal, but the deals are getting bigger for this company.
100%, and it's an important deal because this is a bet on open models, uh, because you've got Hugging Face, which is, uh, sort of a hub for developers with their open models that they can share. And this is Jensen Huang saying, I'm putting 13 billion down on this because there's been this debate about open models versus closed models. Well, now, with this acquisition, this is Nvidia sort of hedging on that, uh, open model sort of a strategy. And if you look at Jensen Huang's comments on X, also, he's saying Nvidia is going to be a great home for Hugging Face, its community, and the future of open models. But as you mentioned, this isn't the only deal that Nvidia has done. I mean, this just adds to the long list of deals. It adds to the acquisition of Grok last year. That was more on the AI inference side, the designer of AI accelerator chips. And also, it brought it bought, uh, Mellanox back in 2019 for 7 billion. But take a look at the whole ecosystem that Nvidia has and all the deals. I mean, you've got just that MediaTek that, uh, the investment in MediaTek just earlier this week. Uh, you had investments in companies like Marvell, like open OpenAI and Thropic. I mean, the list goes on and on in this whole ecosystem that this company is building.
And Inez, more important than the technology Nvidia's getting, they just purchased. They spent $13 billion to buy the corporate logo, perhaps the coolest corporate logo in the game. It's like an emoji with like a smiley face. I mean, it's a home run, Inez.
100%. That emoji says it all of when it was actually started and and and the founders behind it as well. But look, Nvidia, as you mentioned also in one of your pieces, by the way, Saz, now accounts for 8% of the S&P 500's market cap. So, it's got a market cap of 5.4 trillion. That's bigger than five of the S&P 500's 11 sectors. This is just a monster of a company that has been investing heavily in all touch points of the AI trade.
